dedupe_keys.name: meta business activity trends during crisis events and during covid 19

description: Business Activity Trends use the rate at which businesses post on Facebook, compared with pre-crisis levels, to measure how crisis events affect local economic sectors each day and how businesses recover. Meta counts public posts by administrators of business pages before and after an event, compares post-crisis activity with each page's baseline distribution over the previous year, and shares de-identified results aggregated to administrative areas. The crisis collection covers selected events from 2024 and 2025, such as the Rio Grande do Sul floods in Brazil, hurricanes Helene and Beryl, the Los Angeles wildfires and floods in central and eastern Europe, while a companion dataset covers COVID-19 from March 2020 to November 2022 for many countries. Both are published by AI for Good at Meta on the Humanitarian Data Exchange as downloadable CSV files under CC BY. Caveats: the signal covers businesses with Facebook pages, not all firms, and results are available only for events Meta selects. It is useful for calibrating economic recovery curves in resilience and recovery models and for emergency response situational awareness after disasters; a related record is the Global Flood Monitor, another social media based signal.
